'''Ranat's cheese soup''' was a [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]]-based [[Soup/Legends|soup]] associated with the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served Ranat's cheese soup. The diner's menu listed Ranat's cheese soup under the Pantoran Plate Specials section, where it was a [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] soup only sold on [[Primeday/Legends|Primeday]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ranat's cheese soup was mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
